_doc: Endpoint curves of the residual trees (entry 90). PARI/GP 2.17.4 output recorded as data; the suite checks durable invariants (models, torsion points, correspondences) and never runs gp.

k3_H2_quartic.origin: k=3 replications of H2 in the (3,3) box: the Re3-cofactor pin 4U1^2 - 3q^2 = -3p^2 splits as (q-p)/2 = 3a^2, (q+p)/2 = b^2, so q = b^2 + 3a^2, p = b^2 - 3a^2, U1 = 3ab, and V1^2 = q^2 - U1^2 = b^4 - 3a^2 b^2 + 9a^4 must be a square: the quartic y^2 = x^4 - 3x^2 + 9, x = b/a
k3_H2_quartic.rational_points_on_quartic: (0, +-3) and the two points at infinity (leading coefficient 1 is a square); x = b/a = 0 or infinity gives no frame (a, b >= 1)
k3_H2_quartic.conclusion: the branch is empty: rank 0 (Selmer upper bound 0 -- unconditional), E(Q) = the four 2-torsion points
